text: My office has been working with local residents, the Fort York Neighbourhood Association, and City staff around road safety improvements on Bruyeres Mews. Transportation Services staff have already begun working with my office to install crosswalk lines and a yellow divider line at the intersection of Ianuzzi Street and Bruyeres Mews. Resident concerns have focused around vehicles parking in a no standing area on the north side near Bathurst Street, causing congestion and driver frustration, including excessive honking and shouting, as vehicles have limited space to pass. This poses visibility concerns for pedestrians and cyclists. Parking adjustments will improve sightlines at crosswalks and mitigate congestion while still providing some street parking for nearby businesses.
